title: Trump mobs are organizing on CloutHub, not Parler
description_short: Trump mobs are organizing on CloutHub, not Parler
description_medium: Before the January 6, 2021 Capitol attack, WildProtest.com linked to a CloutHub group where Trump supporters discussed finding rides to Washington, according to the supplied timeline. The associated AP report could not be retrieved. The packet does not identify who organized the group, provide dated posts or show that any member participated in violence at the Capitol.

preserved_fields.title: Trump mobs are organizing on CloutHub, not Parler
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump mobs are organizing on CloutHub, not Parler

notes: The AP link returned HTTP 403. The supplied summary says a WildProtest page linked to a CloutHub group where supporters discussed rides, but gives no dated posts, named organizers, or evidence linking a participant to conduct during the Capitol attack.
proposed_correction: Describe the reported ride-coordination link unless dated posts or reporting establishes who organized the group and any participant’s conduct at the Capitol; do not characterize all group members as a mob.

title: Trump: Russia orders ambassador to Moscow, suspends Kentucky investments
description_short: Trump: Russia orders ambassador to Moscow, suspends Kentucky investments
description_medium: The supplied timeline says Russia recalled Ambassador Anatoly Antonov to Moscow on March 17, 2021, after a U.S. intelligence assessment on election interference and President Joe Biden’s remarks about Vladimir Putin. It says Antonov was to consult on the U.S.–Russia relationship. The separate claim that Russia suspended Kentucky investments is not supported by project details or another source in the packet.

preserved_fields.title: Trump: Russia orders ambassador to Moscow, suspends Kentucky investments
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump: Russia orders ambassador to Moscow, suspends Kentucky investments

notes: The timeline’s supplied excerpt supports the ambassador recall but does not identify the Kentucky project, establish a suspension, or connect either action to Trump. The linked page did not expose the relevant article body in the prior review.
proposed_correction: Separate the reported ambassador recall from the unsupported Kentucky-investment claim, and retain the latter only if a source names the project and confirms the decision.

title: Trump: Hungarian and Russian officials caught on intercepts coordinating to block Ukraine from EU
description_short: Trump: Hungarian and Russian officials caught on intercepts coordinating to block Ukraine from EU
description_medium: The supplied timeline attributes to intelligence reporting an allegation that senior Hungarian and Russian officials discussed blocking Ukraine’s European Union accession. It places the claim alongside the December 14, 2023 European Council meeting, but the available excerpt does not identify the officials, describe the intercepts, or provide the reporting behind them. The linked Reuters story is dated 2026 and does not establish this 2023 claim.

preserved_fields.title: Trump: Hungarian and Russian officials caught on intercepts coordinating to block Ukraine from EU
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump: Hungarian and Russian officials caught on intercepts coordinating to block Ukraine from EU

notes: The supplied account does not name the officials or identify the intercepted communication; the other linked article concerns an alleged 2026 wiretapping probe, not the 2023 accession claim. No connection to Trump is established by the supplied facts.
proposed_correction: Use the 2023 intelligence report and underlying intercept evidence to identify the officials and substantiate the allegation; remove the Trump framing unless a direct connection is documented.

title: Trump names bomb thrower Steven Cheung as communications director
description_short: Trump names bomb thrower Steven Cheung as communications director
description_medium: On November 15, 2024, Donald Trump named Steven Cheung, his 2024 campaign spokesperson, as communications director for the incoming administration and selected Karoline Leavitt as press secretary. The announcement identifies two staffing choices for the White House press operation. The supplied sources do not provide enough distinct context for a useful longer account, and “bomb thrower” is editorial characterization.

preserved_fields.title: Trump names bomb thrower Steven Cheung as communications director
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump names bomb thrower Steven Cheung as communications director

notes: The New York Times page returned HTTP 403. The supplied material establishes the two appointments but does not provide concrete responsibilities or consequential actions to support the required longer explanation. The existing national-security category does not fit a routine communications appointment.
proposed_correction: Use a neutral title naming Cheung’s appointment and add an appropriate category only if evidence shows a specific policy or institutional consequence.

title: Trump: White House deletes Spanish website and social media accounts
description_short: Trump: White House deletes Spanish website and social media accounts
description_medium: Hours after Donald Trump’s inauguration on January 20, 2025, the White House’s Spanish-language website and social-media accounts became unavailable, according to the supplied timeline. The linked AP article could not be retrieved. The available account does not say whether the pages were removed temporarily during the transition, replaced elsewhere, or permanently discontinued, and it does not identify which accounts were affected.

preserved_fields.title: Trump: White House deletes Spanish website and social media accounts
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump: White House deletes Spanish website and social media accounts

notes: The AP link returned HTTP 403. The timeline itself says the post would be updated when more context became available; there is no explanation, list of affected accounts, or restoration status in the packet.
proposed_correction: Describe the pages as unavailable after the transition until reporting establishes whether the change was permanent, what accounts were affected, and whether Spanish-language content was restored.
